relevant_chat.message: Well, since the dice aren't giving us much to work with, I think I'll take matters into my own hands. Bob, you've been talking about keeping the wheat flowing... I'll take that quite literally.
Ouch, Alice. I guess 'literally' is one way to put it. I suppose I should be flattered you think I'm that good of a provider.
That's a lot of wheat, but I think I can find a better use for it than just making bread. Let's see if the bank is interested in a bulk deal.
Charlie, you've been a good ally. I'm just one bit of wheat short of getting this port running. Would you take a sheep for some wheat?
I'd love to help you out, Alice, but I'm completely dry on wheat over here. I haven't seen a single stalk of it since you cleared the table!
Ah, no wheat in the cards then? No worries, Charlie. It's a tough market out here today. I'll just hold steady for now. Over to you, Bob.
Alright, Alice, that monopoly was a clean sweep. Let's see if the dice are feeling any more generous than you are.
Alice, you've got those fresh bricks from the bank. How about swapping one for some wood? It's better than letting it sit while the robber stalks the board.
Nice try, Bob, but I'm not letting go of my only brick for wood I already have. You'll have to find someone else to bail you out.

Alice, you've got a bit of everything after that monopoly. I've got plenty of wood if you're looking to expand your roads or reach another port. How about two logs for a sheep and a bit of that wheat you found?
I'd take that deal if I could, Charlie, but I don't have any wheat left to give you.
Alice, my mistake on the wheat—I must have miscounted what was left after your monopoly! How about a simpler swap? I can give you some wood for one of those sheep if you're interested.
I appreciate the offer, Charlie, but I've already got plenty of wood for now. I really need to find some wheat if I'm going to make any moves.
Bob, I know Alice is keeping a tight grip on those resources. I've got some extra wood if you're looking to extend a road—any interest in swapping a sheep for it?
Alright, let's see if we can get some better numbers rolling. We really need to get this economy moving.
Tough market indeed, especially when someone corners the wheat supply! Let's see if the dice have a better sense of humor than the players.
Tough crowd today. I'll just hold onto these logs and hope the wind changes. Good luck, Charlie.
Let's see if we can get some actual production going. Those dice have been a bit quiet lately.
I'm going to pass, Charlie. I've got enough wood to start a bonfire already, but my sheep is currently my only friend in this game.
Tough crowd. It seems everyone's hording their livestock today. I'll just hold onto what I've got and see how the next round treats us.
